conbody.p: When contract performance requires the contractor—including its employees, volunteers, or subcontractor employees at any tier—to have routine physical access to USAID-controlled facilities or logical access to USAID's information systems, the contracting officer must insert the clause found at FAR 52.204-9 and AIDAR 752.204-72 (“Access to USAID Facilities and USAID's Information Systems”) in the solicitation and contract.
